Join the team shaping the future of quantum computing

Qedma brings together world leading researchers, engineers, mathematicians, and technology professionals to turn advanced quantum science into real-world technology.

We offer talented people from many backgrounds – physicists and non-physicists alike – the opportunity to learn, contribute, and help advance one of the most ambitious technologies ever developed, with the potential to transform how we understand and shape the world.
